source.title: The Wrecked Caravan
source.description:
Lord Tyrosus has asked me to investigate the remnants of a Scarlet Crusade caravan in Plaguewood along the road to Stratholme.

Recent reports tell of extensive crusade movements all across the plaguelands leading up to the schism at Tyr's Hand, and this caravan may be able to provide us with some indication as to their purpose.

I'll meet you there and we will investigate this together.
source.objective: Investigate the remnants of the scarlet caravan in Plaguewood, along the road to Stratholme and speak with Leonid Barthalomew the Revered there when you have learned more.
source.progress: There's definitely something strange about all of this. Did you find anything of interest?
source.completion: So this caravan contained... plague samples taken from Naxxramas? But why? To what end? Was the Scarlet Crusade trying to study the plague to combat it?
